verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows vendor-hosted services: the app, the API at api.puzzle.io, the MCP endpoint at app.puzzle.io/mcp, and a vendor-run staging sandbox. Data export and the API are adjacent features and do not show any deployable or self-hostable distribution of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
